title: Programmers
description: config/programmers.yml: the tools that load a bitstream onto a board. A programmer applies to a board through the toolchain it is bundled with, the chip families it supports (with the bridge the board must have), or the bootloader the board runs.

bridge.description: A physical interface: jtag, ft2232h-jtag, usb-dfu, ...

id.description: Lower case, except a tool whose own name is not (openFPGALoader)

bundled.description: The toolchain it ships with, or null for a third-party tool

requires_bridge.description: The bridge a board must have for this programmer

families.description: For a third-party tool: the chip families it targets (ids of config/chips/<producer>/<family>.yml)

requires_bootloader.description: The bootloader a board must run for this programmer
